## Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct API

Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct is a large language model by Mistral AI, available on the Venice API as `mistral-small-3-2-24b-instruct`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Mistral Small 3.2 is a 24B parameter model optimized for efficiency and performance. Ideal for general-purpose tasks with balanced speed and capability.

### Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mistral-small-3-2-24b-instruct` | Standard | Private | $0.0938 / $0.25 per 1M |

### Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Mistral AI |
| Released | Jan 15, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 256K tokens |
| Max output | 16K tokens |
| Served precision | FP8 |

### How to use the Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "mistral-small-3-2-24b-instruct"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "mistral-small-3-2-24b-instruct",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
